Research.name: A Multiclass Image Segmentation Dataset for Waste in Urban Water Bodies of Bangladesh

files.name: README.md
files.content: In Bangladesh, inadequate waste management in canals, lakes, and ponds presents significant environmental and public health challenges. Addressing these issues requires implementing automated monitoring systems. However, the creation of such systems is hindered by the lack of datasets containing real-world waste in unconstrained, complex environments. The proposed WasteSegCluster dataset consists of annotated waste images collected from a variety of water-based environments in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It contains 1,947 images, with nearly 3,900 instances belonging to 4 categories of Composite_Rubber_Textile, Organic, Paper, and Plastic, all annotated using polygon-based masks and released in COCO format to support object detection, instance segmentation and classification problems. The dataset is divided into training (70%), validation (20%), and testing (10%) subsets using stratified sampling. The dataset was evaluated using multiple models. Mask R-CNN achieves an accuracy of 0.90 for instance segmentation, while EfficientNetV2-M and Vision Transformer achieve classification accuracies of 0.92 and 0.89 respectively. These results indicate that the dataset supports model development and evaluation across different architectures.

Research.name: BDWaterSurfaceSet: A Satellite Imagery Dataset for Surface Water Body Segmentation Across Diverse Aquatic Environments

files.name: README.md
files.content: This data article describes the BDWaterSurfaceSet dataset, a collection of satellite imagery for detecting inland water surfaces in Bangladesh. The dataset comprises 3,115 satellite images and 10,142 region-level samples, including 7,112 water-surface and 3,030 non-water-surface regions. Data extraction follows a multi-stage pipeline in which raw satellite images are converted into region crops via binary mask extraction with stratified partitioning to prevent data leakage. A 70/20/10 image-level split is applied across training, validation, and test sets (2180, 623 and 312 images respectively). Four pretrained models were benchmarked for binary classification: ViT-Base-Patch16-224 achieved 0.9991 accuracy (0.9983 precision, 0.9994 recall, 0.9989 F1), DeiT-Base-Patch16-224 achieved 0.9991 accuracy (0.9983 precision, 0.9994 recall, 0.9989 F1), Swin-Tiny-Patch4-Window7-224 achieved 0.9973 accuracy (0.9961 precision, 0.9971 recall, 0.9966 F1), and ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved 0.9982 accuracy (0.9967 precision, 0.9988 recall, 0.9977 F1). The dataset is released in COCO segmentation format with companion annotation files, enabling direct use with standard data loaders for segmentation and classification tasks.

files.name: README.md
files.content: Developed a high-speed Delta parallel robot designed for rapid assembly and precision sorting. Utilizing a parallel kinematic geometry, I synchronized three motors to control spatial coordinates via complex inverse kinematics. This design ensures the end-effector remains stable and parallel to the work surface, enabling high-acceleration movements and exceptional repeatability.

files.name: README.md
files.content: Designed and prototyped a 4-axis SCARA robotic arm utilizing 3D-printed components and an Arduino Nano. The project focuses on high-precision movement for automated pick-and-place tasks. I implemented the kinematics logic to control joint rotations, ensuring smooth trajectories while optimizing the arm’s reach and payload stability.

files.content: DirectEdge revolutionizes sourcing by connecting businesses directly with farmers, streamlining distribution for fresher, sustainable goods. As an all-in-one solution, we manage procurement through delivery via a transparent supply chain. We’ve integrated a compact, user-friendly POS and ERP system alongside advanced demand forecasting to optimize efficiency. By eliminating intermediaries, we ensure competitive pricing for businesses and fair compensation for farmers. Join us in building a smarter, data-driven, and sustainable food system.
